help: The identifier of the charge to be captured.
name: charge
label: Charge to capture

help: A positive integer in the [smallest currency unit](https://support.stripe.com/questions/which-zero-decimal-currencies-does-stripe-support) (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 or 100 to charge ¥100, a 0-decimal currency) representing how much to capture. The amount to capture, which must be less than or equal to the original amount. Any additional amount will be automatically refunded.
name: amount
label: Amount

help: An application fee to add on to this charge. Can only be used with Stripe Connect.
name: application_fee
label: Application fee

help: A dictionary containing a new destination amount to use. Can only be used with destination charges created with Stripe Connect.
name: destination

spec.help: The portion of this charge to send to the destination account.
spec.name: amount
spec.label: Amount

label: Destination

help: This will override the previously-specified email address for this charge, if one was set.
name: receipt_email
label: Receipt email
